events.title: C.A.G.E. is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is here, and C.A.G.E. is taking part!C.A.G.E. is a first-person narrative adventure that begins as a dark workplace comedy and gradually bends into psychological horror. events.title: Demo Update v0.31
events.summary: While continuing to work on the full game, I'm also not forgetting about providing you, early players, with a good Demo experience! That's why occasionally I still update the demo with some additional fixes and interactions. events.title: The C.A.G.E. Demo is OUT NOW!
events.summary: Hi everyone,I'm thrilled to announce that after months of solo development, the C.A.G.E. Demo is officially live and ready for you to play.You can now download the 45-minute preview (or perhaps a lot longer, if you wish to find everything it has to offer) and step into the unnerving hallways of Spire Corporation.
